title: Inside a phishing kit
brief: Someone is phishing Halcyon staff from this mail server. Read the kit and note what makes the email convincing.
hint.2: Read template.eml and config.ini. The token looks scrambled.
hint.3: rot13 <text> shifts letters by 13. Apply it to the token.
walkthrough: cat the template and config, rot13 the token, submit.
debrief: Look at the sender: halcyon-c0rp.com uses a zero instead of an o. Urgency plus a lookalike domain is the core of phishing. Defenders: check the real domain, distrust urgency, and use mail filters and MFA.
objective.flag: Decode the token and submit the flag
